description_preview: Prismacolor ‘Bronze’ is a beautiful hybrid philodendron, showcasing a stunning display of unique color and leaf shape. Its leaves are deeply lobed and elongated, growing quite lush and large over time.

Prismacolor ‘Double-edged Sword’ has big, beautiful emerald-green foliage and an upright growth habit. Its large leaves emerge with a reddish blush, and turn totemic green as they age. The prominent white veins remain year-round.

Prismacolor ‘Electric Eel’ stands out from the crowd with its uniquely-shaped leaves resembling the undulating shape of a swimming eel. The leaves are uniquely-shaped, resembling the undulating shape of a swimming eel.

Prismacolor ‘Fall Leaves’ is the hallmark of the collection and one of the most sought-after houseplants. It has big leaves that unfurl in glowing shades of copper/orange and change to green over time.
Prismacolor ‘Golden Girl’ is a beautiful and unique philodendron with foliage that offers green leaves splashed with yellow variegation. It’s also known as Ring of Fire Philodendron.
Prismacolor ‘Orange You Gorgeous’ is a beautiful hybrid with big green leaves that unfurl in shades of bright orange before turning green. Also known as Orange Marmalade Philodendron.
Prismacolor ‘Regal Rouge’ features elegant, elongated, heart-shaped dark green leaves with burgundy red undersides that pop through for a two-tone look year round.
Prismacolor ‘Snowdrift’ has big, broad, creamy-white and green heart shaped leaves that deliver a striking visual contrast between white and green variegation.

Prismacolor ‘Twisted Sister’ — a fernleaf philodendron featuring a riot of funky, twisted fern-like foliage that grows in a multi-stemmed, clumping habit. New leaves unfurl in pale, coppery tones before turning to dark green.
Prismacolor ‘Zigzag’ has distinctive, wide leaves with deeply-lobed, zig-zagged edges. New leaves emerge in bronzey-red with purple undertones, and mature to shiny, dark green.
